key_insight: PAHD uses large language models to turn hypertension exercise studies into a structured, queryable evidence database with source-linked values.
clinical_relevance: A clinician-facing portal retrieves studies matched to hypertension stage and comorbidities, supporting evidence review rather than establishing individualized exercise prescriptions.
method: An LLM screened 2,548 PubMed records and selected 255 studies.
LLMs extracted study arms, exercise protocols, participant characteristics and outcomes, with dual-LLM structure checks and verbatim source quotes.
Programmatic integration produced 17,273 standardized comparison records from 253 studies.
evidence_signal: Against adjudicated benchmarks, screening achieved 86.3% recall and 80.6% precision; blood pressure value extraction achieved 90.1% recall and 90.5% precision.
watch_item: Screening and extraction errors remain, and the abstract does not report validation of patient-level recommendations or clinical outcomes.
paper_title: A Knowledge Database of Physical Activity Interventions for Hypertension using Large Language Models
